clock_and_reset_waveform.ACLK: Single rising-edge clock per AXI interface.
clock_and_reset_waveform.ARESETn: Active LOW. Async assert; sync deassert. After ARESETn=HIGH, earliest rising ACLK edge that the master may drive VALID HIGH is one cycle later (see Figure A3-1 'Exit from reset').

handshake_waveforms.sequence: Source asserts VALID; destination later asserts READY; transfer on next ACLK rising edge.
Destination asserts READY; source later asserts VALID; transfer on next ACLK rising edge.
Both asserted in same cycle; transfer occurs on that rising ACLK edge.

arrows: RREADY -> next ARVALID (master can issue more)

write_AXI3.note: AXI3 BVALID depends only on W handshake + WLAST, NOT on AW handshake.

write_AXI4_AXI5.note: AXI4/AXI5 add an additional slave dependency on AW handshake before BVALID, so slaves never need to buffer write data without the address.

max_outstanding_rules.same_ID_ordering: All transactions with the same AXI ID must remain in order (request order = response order).
max_outstanding_rules.different_ID_reordering: Transactions with different IDs may be reordered by the interconnect or slave.
max_outstanding_rules.different_ID_ordering: No ordering constraint between different IDs.
max_outstanding_rules.implementation_defined_max: Maximum outstanding transactions is implementation-defined per master+ID pair.
max_outstanding_rules.no_outstanding_count_in_spec: Spec defines no maximum number of outstanding transactions; an implementation-defined value.
max_outstanding_rules.read_response_ordering: Read data for the same ARID is returned in order.
max_outstanding_rules.read_reordering_depth: Implementation-defined; describes how many outstanding read transactions with different ARIDs may be in flight before the master needs to stall.

narrow_transfer_waveforms: Narrow-bus transfers (transfer width < bus width) use the address+size pair to determine byte lanes per beat; refer to spec figure for example with 5-beat 8-bit incrementing burst on a 32-bit data bus.
write_response_dependency_rules: AXI3: BVALID may be asserted as soon as W handshake completes + WLAST=1, even before AW handshake.
AXI4/AXI5: BVALID may only be asserted after BOTH (AW handshake AND W handshake with WLAST=1) complete.
Same-ID write transactions: BRESP must follow same-AWID order of acceptance.

clock_and_reset_waveform.ACLK: Single rising-edge clock per ACE interface.
clock_and_reset_waveform.ARESETn: Active LOW. Async assert; sync deassert.

handshake_waveforms_inherited_axi.sequence: Source VALID at T1; READY at T2; Transfer at T3.
READY at T1; VALID at T2; Transfer at T3.

handshake_waveforms_inherited_axi.case: VALID with READY same cycle (Figure A3-4)
handshake_waveforms_inherited_axi.sequence: Both at T1; Transfer at T2.

arrows: ACVALID must not depend on ACREADY
CRVALID/CDVALID must not depend on CRREADY/CDREADY

ace_snoop_dependency_diagram.summary: Interconnect drives ACVALID independent of ACREADY. Master may default ACREADY=HIGH or wait. Master must wait for both ACVALID + ACREADY before CRVALID and CDVALID. If DataTransfer=1, master delivers CD beats (CDDATA + CDLAST) gated by CDREADY.

sequence: T0: Master drives AR* + ARDOMAIN/ARSNOOP/ARBAR; ARVALID.
T1: ARREADY HIGH; AR handshake complete.
T2+: Interconnect issues snoops on AC channel.
T3+: Other masters drive ACREADY; deliver CRRESP/CD.
T5+: Interconnect aggregates; drives R + RRESP[3:0].
T9: Master asserts RREADY; RLAST=1 on final beat.
T10: Master pulses RACK for one ACLK cycle.
T0: Master drives AW* + AWDOMAIN/AWSNOOP/AWBAR; AWVALID.
T0: Master may drive WDATA + WSTRB + WLAST.
T1+: AW and W handshakes complete (any order).
T6: Master asserts BREADY; B handshake complete.
T7: Master pulses WACK for one ACLK cycle.

fields.snoop_response_ordering_rule: Each snoop transaction is fully ordered: response on CR must be in the same order as addresses on AC. Master may not reorder snoops issued by the interconnect.

max_outstanding_rules_inherited.same_AxID_ordering: All transactions with the same AXI ID must remain in order.
max_outstanding_rules_inherited.different_AxID_ordering: No ordering constraint between different IDs.
max_outstanding_rules_inherited.ACE_snoop_ordering: Snoop responses on CR follow AC address order.

fields.ace_lite_no_snoop_channels: ACE-Lite masters have no AC/CR/CD channels. They observe RRESP[3:2] / BRESP[2] but do not participate in snoop traffic.
